Calculate $\Delta G$ for the isothermal expansion of $2.25 \mathrm{~mol}$ of an ideal gas
at $325 \mathrm{~K}$ from an initial pressure of 12.0 bar to a final pressure of 2.5 bar.
Why are there no impact craters on the surface of Io?

options.A: Any craters that existed have been eroded through the strong winds on Io's surface.
options.B: Io is protected by a layer of gas that prevents any objects from reaching its surface.
options.C: The gravitational pull of nearby moons prevent objects from hitting Io.
options.D: Io's magnetic field deflects incoming asteroids, preventing impact craters.
options.E: Io did have impact craters but they have all been buried in lava flows.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Io did have impact craters but they have all been buried in lava flows.
